# Q&A Support Bot

> A Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) support chatbot that turns website content into a searchable knowledge base.

## Overview

Q&A Support Bot crawls a website, extracts readable content, chunks and embeds that content, stores it in Pinecone, and lets users ask questions with answers grounded in retrieved context.

## Key Features

- Crawl websites, including JavaScript-rendered pages.
- Optionally read sitemap.xml and llms.txt from crawled sites.
- Split website text into searchable chunks.
- Generate embeddings with Google Gemini.
- Store and query vectors in Pinecone.
- Chat with ingested website content using Gemini.
- Save ingested sites and chat history locally in the browser.

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 15
- React 19
- Google Gemini
- LangChain
- Pinecone
- Playwright
- Tailwind CSS

## Important Pages

- Home: /
- Chat: /chat

## Repository Information

This project is intended as a full-stack RAG application for learning and demonstrating website-based knowledge retrieval and AI-powered support chat.
